name: Dynamic Holdings Limited
summary: Dynamic Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the property investment and property development in the People's Republic of China and Hong Kong. The company's investment properties portfolio comprises offices, shopping malls, car parks, and other amenities, as well as residential, commercial, and retail properties. It is also involved in the property leasing operation business. Dynamic Holdings Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Causeway Bay, Hong Kong.
